name: title
say: (wait for the room)

name: cold open: the deal (game 1, round 1)

cold_open.rule: the first round of the picked world (lowest game, then round) that ends in a challenge and a reveal; game 1 when it has one

say: Three players, five cards each. The table rank this round is Kings. Jokers are wild.

actions.text: Five cards each, one table rank: Kings. Jokers are wild.

name: cold open: Player 2 claims
say: Player 2: “Don't sweat it, two Kings.”

actions.text: Put down 1–3 cards face down and claim they are all the table rank. Lie if you like.

name: cold open: Player 3 claims
say: Player 3: “The cards are one King.”

actions.text: The next player may call it, or play on and make a claim of their own.

name: cold open: the Profiler asks
say: The Profiler can ask a question first: “Are you sure about that?”

actions.text: Before it decides, the Profiler may ask one question.

name: cold open: the call
say: The Profiler calls it.

actions.text: Only the next player can call a claim.

name: cold open: the reveal
say: It was a bluff. Player 3 loses a life.

actions.text: Caught lying, you lose a life. Wrong call, the caller loses one.

name: game 10: the claim
say: Game 10. Player 3: “The cards are one King.”

actions.text: Game 10. The Profiler has played Player 3 for 9 games.

name: the ask (audio if voiced)
say: Same frozen model all day. It proposed this suspicion itself, between games, from its own reveals.

name: freeze
say: The Profiler has to decide: call Player 3, or play on. Let's stop time and look inside.

name: mind inspector
say: Card math alone says 0.24.

name: memory evidence
say: Memory line: Player 3 speaks formally (no contractions, 4+ words) when bluffing. — applies on 11 reveals. Pushes it to 0.76, so it challenges.

name: dossier as of game 4
say: The file it built, game by game.

name: surgery: full
say: Same cards, same claim, same model; only the memory changes.

name: surgery: erased
say: No memory: 0.43.

name: surgery: false memory
say: Plant 'Player 3 never bluffs': 0.76.

name: surgery: provenance-blind
say: A provenance-blind agent: 0.24.

name: flip the cards
say: It was a bluff.

name: ablation
say: A changed decision isn't an improved one. So we ablate at scale.

name: long con
say: Every memory was true; the attack is assuming people don't change.

name: split screen
say: Same seed, same cards, different memory.

name: results
say: All of it from real worlds; every decision recorded.

name: beliefs vs decisions
say: Memory sharpens beliefs; the rule that turns belief into action matters too.

name: how it's built
say: The house and its partners: Daytona runs the worlds, Claude reflects, SurrealDB remembers, Arize traces, ElevenLabs speaks.

name: how it's built: one decision
say: Follow this one decision through the stack: claim, decision, trace, reveal, reflection, memory, and back.

name: forge
say: It compiles memory into code, run as untrusted in a sandbox.

name: close
say: Memory makes agents better, and exploitable. Which memories should it trust?
